summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K attaching summarized board minutes dated May 28, 2026, reporting the removal of Officer Luís Eduardo Gross Siqueira Cunha effective March 31, 2026. The action was a unanimous board resolution with no stated cause, price, or consideration. As a non-US filing, this is equivalent to a material definitive agreement or change in directors/principal officers under US rules. No advisors, deal terms, or regulatory clock are mentioned. Watch for further disclosures on succession or potential underlying governance disputes.
